sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
A native Seeker, Teeg and Galen grew up in [[Baja California, Mexico]] and eventually became allies of the [[Huntik Foundation]]. He trained with his brother in New York City with the Foundation, but stood out as they had learnt their powers through their ancient traditions. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

Teeg and Galen, helped [[Dante Vale]] find [[Hernán Cortés' vault]] using Galen's maps and records. {{Source|Gremlow Infestation!}} The pair later hosted his team as they prepared for their mission to recover the [[Ring]] of [[Umbra]]. Teeg gave the [[Amulet]] of [[Kaioh the Tracker]] to [[Den Fears]] after telling him he could relate to his experience of being new to the world of Seekers. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

full_text:
Teeg is a Native Kumeyaay Huntik Foundation Seeker based in Baja California, Mexico. As an archaeologist, he and his brother, Galen, are experts on Hernán Cortés.

== History ==
A native Seeker, Teeg and Galen grew up in Baja California, Mexico and eventually became allies of the Huntik Foundation. He trained with his brother in New York City with the Foundation, but stood out as they had learnt their powers through their ancient traditions. [The Power of Umbra]

Teeg and Galen, helped Dante Vale find Hernán Cortés' vault using Galen's maps and records. [Gremlow Infestation!] The pair later hosted his team as they prepared for their mission to recover the Ring of Umbra. Teeg gave the Amulet of Kaioh the Tracker to Den Fears after telling him he could relate to his experience of being new to the world of Seekers. [The Power of Umbra]

== Personality ==
Teeg is friendly with a sense of humour, joking to Dante that he will be in big trouble if he hadn't returned with his cook book. He is also quite insightful, picking up just from the team's behavior that Den is new to the group. He relates to this, telling Den him and his brother stuck out like sore thumbs when they first joined the Foundation. [The Power of Umbra] He is more laid-back and adventurous than his scholarly brother, and, aside from being a passionate cook, Teeg enjoys listening to music.

== Abilities ==
Teeg possesses Seeker abilities and is known to have made use of the Titan, Kaioh the Tracker. In addition to being a Seeker, Teeg is an adept cook.
